title: thelypteris juruensis
intro: Thelypteris juruensis, commonly known as the Andean maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the Andes mountain range in South America and is prized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris juruensis include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
